overall_goal: Wash utensils, monitor the baking pizza, handle a smoke alarm, and serve the pizza

goals.description: Monitor the pizza baking in the oven
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly opens and closes the pizza oven lid to check on the baking progress.

goals.description: Wash the wooden spoon and scissors
goals.rationale: The person prepares the sponge with washing up liquid and scrubs the wooden spoon and scissors.

goals.description: Rinse the utensils and dry hands
goals.rationale: The person turns on the tap, rinses the washed utensils, places them in the drying rack, and dries their hands.

goals.description: Turn the pizza and absorb excess moisture
goals.rationale: The person uses spatulas to turn the pizza in the oven and dabs it with kitchen paper to remove moisture.

goals.description: Turn off the oven and handle the smoke alarm
goals.rationale: The person checks the pizza, turns off the oven, and addresses the triggered smoke alarm by shushing it and opening the door.

goals.description: Remove the pizza from the oven and serve
goals.rationale: The person takes the baked pizza out of the oven, dabs it again, and places the plate on the table.
